GitHub Issue:
Post Date: 2019-10-11T13:35:45Z
Current Date: April 4 2025
Title: NO_COLOR does not work with Ink 
Description: Ink uses chalk internally which does a bunch of magic to figure out whether to render colours or not. 

In /packages/gatsby-cli/src/reporter/index.js we try to set `FORCE_COLOR` to 0 but that is too late because chalk has already initialised and set colours to true.
